description: This Java source file defines an Activity class 'FragmentRetainInstance' demonstrating the use of retained Fragments within the Android framework to manage ongoing background work across configuration changes. It contains nested static classes for the UI fragment and a retained fragment that manages a background thread updating a progress bar.

classes.name: FragmentRetainInstance
classes.description: The main Activity class demonstrating fragment retention and state propagation.

classes.name: FragmentRetainInstance$UiFragment
classes.description: A UI fragment hosting a button to restart the background thread.

classes.name: FragmentRetainInstance$RetainedFragment
classes.description: A retained fragment that manages a background thread updating a progress bar to simulate ongoing work across configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Activity and adds the UI fragment if it's the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and sets up the button click listener to restart the worker thread.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the retained worker fragment and associates it with the activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: In RetainedFragment, sets the fragment to be retained across configuration changes and starts the background thread.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves the progress bar view and signals the thread to proceed.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops the background thread when the fragment is being destroyed.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Prepares the fragment for disconnection from the activity and stops thread interactions.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Resets the progress and restarts the background thread's work.
